'''2014 Worlds Day 2 John Anderson DS Hunt Down''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[John Anderson]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name HD. John Anderson / puck71, 2014 Worlds Day 2 8/23/14, 2013 form.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe]]
* '''Username:''' puck71
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
